purpose: Test whether an outcome-blind FaaSRank-admissible OCS choice at every parent-complete stage, followed by a dual FaaSRank-and-OCS whole-window certificate, can retain V83 throughput while removing the latency deficit that prevented formal QPR dominance.

diagnosis_frozen_before_implementation.code_level_mechanistic_difference: V83 already has lower cost and higher throughput than OCS, but its latency is 27.18 ms higher. V83 sends only sink functions to OCS and protects only terminal OCS scores in its routed certificate, leaving 70.25% of players and the complete-window latency surrogate unprotected.
diagnosis_frozen_before_implementation.root_cause_hypothesis: The remaining QPR deficit is a latency-path problem rather than a throughput or cost problem. Selecting OCS for any parent-complete player only when that exact OCS choice is nonworse under the same current FaaSRank score can expose warm-affinity latency gains without knowingly giving up the frozen throughput proxy. Requiring both complete-window FaaSRank and complete-window OCS scores to be nonworse prevents Nash coordination from undoing either surrogate.

scientific_boundary.E590_E599_disposition: V83 result-blind screen evidence; retained and never pooled into V84
scientific_boundary.E600_E619_disposition: V83 dedicated formal-confirmation evidence; retained, V83 family closed, aggregate diagnosis only
scientific_boundary.V83_formal_baseline_use: The nine E600-E619 baseline arithmetic means are frozen only as fixed candidate-only development-screen thresholds. They are not pooled into V84 formal confirmation and are not claimed as same-seed V84 evidence.

candidate.player_frontier: PreAllDone: every parent of a scheduled function has completed
candidate.native_faasrank_choice: Reproduce the frozen faithful FaaSRank sequential score, deterministic epsilon-greedy selection and rolling actual-selection history on the current preselection state.
candidate.ocs_choice: Compute the exact frozen OCS current-demand best node on the identical preselection state and feasible candidate set.
candidate.admissibility_rule: Choose the OCS node iff its current frozen FaaSRank score plus the implementation EPSILON is at least the current frozen FaaSRank score of the faithful native selected node; otherwise choose the faithful native node. This is a score-Pareto constraint, not a fitted weight or threshold.
candidate.history_rule: Update the faithful FaaSRank rolling history with the actual selected node after every player, including an admissible OCS selection.
candidate.coordination: The unchanged paper-utility best response produces a proposal. An atomic complete-window guard accepts it only when immutable-baseline paper social welfare strictly improves, the reconstructed complete-assignment faithful FaaSRank sequential score is nonworse, and the reconstructed complete-assignment exact OCS sequential score is nonworse; otherwise it restores the initializer and baseline signal.

implementation_tests_required_before_bui: the registered V84 profile round-trips and uses the parent-complete frontier
the faithful native node exactly reproduces the frozen FaaSRank deterministic epsilon-greedy path on a controlled fixture
the exact OCS node is selected when its FaaSRank score is nonworse than the faithful native selected node
the faithful native node is retained when the OCS node has a worse FaaSRank score
the actual selected node, not either unselected expert node, updates the rolling FaaSRank history
the atomic guard requires strict immutable-baseline paper-welfare improvement plus nonworse complete FaaSRank and complete OCS sequential scores
failure of either surrogate certificate restores the complete initializer assignment and baseline price signal
the policy-independent reference key, player order and objective remain unchanged
all previously registered profiles and all sche_nash tests remain unchanged

screen_matrix.baseline_benchmark_source: Frozen V83 formal E600-E619 baseline arithmetic means

execution_order: Commit this V84 plan before modifying scheduler code or generating any E620-E649 artifact.
Implement only the single V84 profile and required observability; do not change a baseline, paper utility, reference search, common HPA, workload or environment weight.
Pass focused admissible-router and dual-certificate tests, all sche_nash tests, rustfmt, cargo check and a release build; freeze source commit and binary hash before input generation.
Generate only E620-E629 candidate-only screen inputs; capture each base tape once, derive one scale5 tape per seed, and build ten state-matched references.
Execute exactly ten candidate runs strictly serially without opening intermediate QC or performance output.
Require ten attempt-one QC passes, zero quarantine, exact frozen runtime identity and a result-free audit before simultaneous reveal.
Compare the three candidate arithmetic means only with the three frozen V83 formal baseline thresholds; report one-sample BCa intervals without changing the screen mean gate.
If and only if all three screen mean gates pass, freeze the unchanged candidate and commit a formal-confirmation execution receipt before generating E630-E649 inputs.

For formal confirmation, generate fresh paired E630-E649 inputs, run all nine baselines and the unchanged candidate, and require all three candidate means to exceed the same-seed best baseline plus all three paired BCa 95% lower bounds to be greater than zero.
If any screen or formal gate fails, retain all artifacts, do not tune on those seeds and close the V84 family.

analysis.throughput: Arithmetic mean fixed-window throughput across all ten E620-E629 candidate runs.
analysis.qpr_finite_only: Arithmetic mean per-run fixed-window throughput divided by drained-cohort mean latency and cost across finite positive-completion runs.
analysis.qpr_zero_completed_as_zero: The same per-run QPR with undefined or zero-completion runs assigned zero over all ten seeds.
analysis.screen_threshold_source: The immutable V83 E600-E619 nine-baseline arithmetic-mean maxima committed before V84 implementation.
analysis.screen_gate: The candidate must strictly exceed all three frozen thresholds; ties fail.
analysis.screen_uncertainty: Report candidate-minus-fixed-threshold one-sample BCa 95% intervals without changing the arithmetic-mean gate.
analysis.formal_baseline_threshold: For each metric, the largest arithmetic mean among the nine fresh same-seed E630-E649 baselines.
analysis.formal_gate: All three candidate means must strictly exceed their fresh same-seed baseline maxima and all three candidate-minus-best-baseline paired BCa 95% lower bounds must be strictly greater than zero.
analysis.mechanism_diagnostics: After each complete result-free audit, report faithful/admissible player counts, dual guard disposition and the two score deltas; these cannot alter a frozen decision.
analysis.screen_success_action: Authorize preparation, but not success, of the untouched E630-E649 formal confirmation block.
analysis.failure_action: Retain every artifact, do not tune on revealed seeds, generate no reserved inputs after a screen failure, and close the V84 family.
